titlePlain: Network Policies: Restricting Which Pods Can
subtitle: Lesson 16 · Kubernetes Networking

steps.label: Default cluster
steps.sub: any Pod can reach any Pod, any namespace

steps.label: CNI plugin
steps.sub: Calico, Cilium, etc. — must enforce it to matter

code:
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: allow-frontend-to-api
  namespace: billing
spec:
  podSelector:
    matchLabels:
      app: payments-api
  policyTypes:
    - Ingress
  ingress:
    - from:
        - podSelector:
            matchLabels:
              app: frontend
      ports:
        - protocol: TCP
          port: 8080
caption: Only Pods labeled app: frontend may reach payments-api, and only on TCP 8080.

eyebrow: The standard pattern: deny all first
code:
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: default-deny-all
  namespace: billing
spec:
  podSelector: {}
  policyTypes:
    - Ingress
    - Egress
caption: podSelector: {} matches every Pod in the namespace; no rules listed means nothing gets through.

code:
kubectl get networkpolicy -n billing
kubectl describe networkpolicy allow-frontend-to-api -n billing
caption: describe prints the pod selector, allowed peers, and allowed ports — the fastest way to spot a label mismatch.
